why_resubmitted: Coordinator note of 9 Nov about 23:28 UTC, relaying the Mac runner: the nebius H200 listed at $5.55/h bills $6.69/h and offers under $4.98/h (A100 80GB, H100) were scarce, so the caps of 002/003 (which covered at most $4.98/h) fitted no offer for more than 30 minutes. New caps follow the runner's rule 6.69 x (max_hours + 0.25): $15.72 -> 15.8 (004), $16.39 -> 16.45 (005); both below the $25 auto-start limit, together $32.25 of the study cap of $35.
code_changes_6537dbe92_to_e24bc7b04: job.sh: hard time bound B5_JOB_HARD_S (seconds from the start of the script, set 660 s below the runner's kill time max_hours x 3600); every world's deadlines are clipped to it (certification deadline <= hard end - 700 s, training <= certification - 240 s, simulation <= training - 300 s; a world with less than that left is skipped and the job fails) and every stage runs under `timeout` (csim: its deadline + 120 s; ctrain: the certification deadline; certification workers: that + 240 s; ccombine: 420 s). Runner's review: the old code bound of r5-bias2-003 was 7,745 s against a kill time of 7,560 s.

job.sh: plan deadlines shortened to fit (membrane 900 / 3600 / 3900 s and gliders 600 / 1400 / 1650 s instead of 1200 / 4000 / 4500 and 600 / 1500 / 1800; vortex 3000 / 6250 / 6550 s instead of 3000 / 6400 / 6900).

job.sh: lat/DONE is touched right after the ctrain line whatever its exit status (ctrain writes it only once main() runs, so a death at import left the certification workers polling to the deadline). Runner's review.
job.sh: exits at once (code 3) if jax.default_backend() is not 'gpu' (skipped in the CPU code-path test B5_TINY=1). Runner's review.
csim.py: the early abort of a too-slow simulation now requires the projected time of both halves to fit in 85% of the time left to the simulation deadline (it had no margin). Runner's review.
ccert.py: claim() tolerates a .ready marker that another worker renamed between the directory listing and the sort (os.path.getmtime in try/except OSError). Runner's review.
cpair.py (new, local analysis only, not run on the pod): paired trajectory bootstrap of closure-ceiling differences between two Phi from the per-item errors.
cpu_smoke_tests: job.sh end to end at tiny size (B5_TINY=1, CPU, one certification worker) from a git archive of exactly the requested paths at e24bc7b04: both exact request environments (r5-bias2-004: membrane + gliders with B5_JOB_HARD_S=6900; r5-bias2-005: vortex with B5_JOB_HARD_S=7260) exit 0; the clipped-deadline path (B5_JOB_HARD_S=1500: membrane runs with clipped deadlines, gliders skipped, exit 1) and the all-skipped path (B5_JOB_HARD_S=700, exit 1) behave as designed.
note_requested_paths: The requested paths at both request commits (11c116b39, bb0bfb923) are identical to the tested code commit e24bc7b04 (git diff empty).
review_of_004_005: origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-bias2-004/review.md (same text for 005): fine to run; 2 minor points not yet fixed because no further job was submitted: (1) ctrain killed at the certification deadline would report a false failure and leave no train_done.json (did not happen: both runs finished training 2,000-4,700 s before their deadlines); (2) the pre-loop probes in job.sh have no timeout.
